$note: 遷移宮（2026-10-12）：七殺.遷移。《深造講義》下篇 宮垣論 遷移宮 p.496–515。客死異鄉、異鄉染病、官非、冤獄、被盜、意外一類斷語不用；天月、天刑、龍池鳳閣等引擎冇嘅星不用；要睇廟陷嘅條文暫不用。

rules.text: 七殺在遷移宮，你在外一般有權，令人敬畏。
rules.en: With Qi Sha in your Travel Palace, you generally carry authority away from home, and people hold you in awe.

rules.text: 七殺見〔輔佐吉星〕，你在外有地位，也多發展的機會。
rules.en: Qi Sha meets 〔helper stars〕: away from home you have standing and plenty of room to grow.

source.quote: 主在外有地位，且多发展的机会

rules.text: 七殺與擎羊或陀羅同宮，你在外人緣較少，現代可從事工藝。
rules.en: Qi Sha with Qing Yang or Tuo Luo: you have fewer friends away from home; these days, skilled trades suit you.

rules.text: 同宮有火星，在外會突然發起來；只是易得易失，要見好就收。
rules.en: With Huo Xing in the palace, sudden success comes away from home; but what comes easily goes easily, so know when to stop.

rules.text: 同宮有鈴星，你在外適合從事工藝、工業。
rules.en: With Ling Xing in the palace, craft or industrial work suits you away from home.

source.quote: 现代亦可从事工艺、工业

rules.text: 同宮有地空地劫，理想常超過現實，不守一業、不守一地；宜做工藝、工業，靠新意念開創。
rules.en: With Di Kong or Di Jie in the palace, your ideals outrun reality, and you do not stay in one job or place; craft or industry suits you, where new ideas can build something.
